description: Ministry of Labour -The Cost of Living Index Number for the Month of March 2015 Applicable to workers in the Cocoa Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade is 178.1 and the Special Allowance Payable to warkers in respect of a normal working day in the Month of April 2015 will be Rs. 548.84
categorisation: This gazette notification contains a declaration of the Cost of Living Index Number and a special allowance payable to workers, issued under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. This constitutes a regulatory matter and the publication of a statutory instrument, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
